summary: Ravalli County tower site about 5 miles east of Stevensville, listed as gone; one bare 1972 entry, with no build, staffing or removal details found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone by firelookout.org; the county index says removed. No removal date is confirmed.

events.note: Entry reads '1972: tower. Gone.' It does not say whether 1972 is the build year or the removal year.

notes_for_editor: Three one-line listings only. No build date, builder, staffing or removal date found. Two web searches returned nothing specific to this lookout. The 1972 entry is ambiguous. Brief coordinates match firelookout.org. Access left unknown because no source addresses it. The site is listed under Montana DNRC, not a Forest Service unit.
